failureCases.message: @user hi there! is it possible to remove a project from spotify, but reupload a single song from the project & keep the plays/streams if using same ISRC, audio file, track name, artist name?
failureCases.escalationReason: Standard feature request handled by KB with 78.6% similarity
failureCases.reply: Hi @user! Unfortunately, removing a project and re‑uploading a single track while keeping the original streams isn’t supported. Even if you use the same ISRC, audio file, track name, and artist name, the track will be treated as a new upload and streams won’t carry over. For a more detailed review, please reach out to our Artist Services team: [LINK] or DM us with your account details. Thanks for understanding!

failureCases.message: @user My playlists don't sync between the Desktop app (on Mac), my phone (Android), and the web player. They're all different. Please help.
failureCases.escalationReason: Classifier confidence (0.60) is below the required 0.65 threshold for automated handling
failureCases.reply: Hey @user! 👋 It sounds like your playlists aren’t syncing across all devices. Let’s get this sorted. Could you please share the following details for each device? 1️⃣ OS & app version on your Mac (Desktop app) 2️⃣ Android OS & Spotify app version on your phone 3️⃣ Browser version you’re using on the web player. Once we have that, we can check your sync settings, make sure “Download on cellular” is set appropriately, and try a quick log‑out/log‑in cycle. If the problem persists, DM us your account email and we’ll dig deeper. Thanks for your patience!

failureCases.reply: Hi @user! Unfortunately, we don’t have a way to filter out specific genres from Discover Weekly or Release Radar.
